description: The two answers one kept item is checked by (BUILD-PLAN F56).

asserted.description: Whether the user's own words settled it, rather than a question, a proposal, a request for the task at hand, or pasted text.

in_effect.description: Whether the item still stands at the end of the entries shown, or a later turn reversed or replaced it.

reason.description: One short sentence saying what in the entries decides it, either way.
